t: Pythonic Chunk-Yielding Generator to Simulate Long-Running Tasks
s: The article advocates for an iterative, step-by-step approach to implementing real-time streaming responses in web applications, specifically avoiding the accumulation of all data before display. It proposes using a plugin system to simulate chunk yielding without altering existing code.
sub: Simulating streaming with a plugin-based chunk yielder
Leveraging actual source code over generic LLM context files
